children: 12:01 ET--Gold futures are higher with Treasury yields easing further and the dollar losing ground. "Lower U.S. Treasury yields and a weaker dollar are creating favorable conditions for gold, but this represents only a short-term improvement," XS.com market analyst Linh Tran says in a note. The near-term outlook will depend heavily on upcoming U.S. economic data,  she adds. The recovery is expected to continue, although "the advance is unlikely to follow a straight line, particularly with several important U.S. employment and inflation reports approaching." Gold for December delivery rises 2.8% to $4,536.90 a troy ounce. Silver gains 3.2% to $67.54 a troy ounce. (anthony.harrup@wsj.com)
